title: Hot Crisp Turkish Cacao Kazandibi
description: A spicy and energizing Turkish dessert featuring cacao, with a crispy texture and low sodium content, achieved through a shio-cure process.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a medium bowl, whisk together the cacao powder, shio salt, sugar, and cayenne pepper.
In a large bowl, whip the egg whites until stiff peaks form.
Add the water, melted butter, and vanilla extract to the egg mixture and whip until combined.
Gradually add the dry ingredients to the egg mixture and whip until smooth.
Pour the mixture onto the prepared baking sheet and spread evenly.
Bake for 20 minutes or until the edges are crispy and the center is set.
Remove from the oven and let cool completely.
Break into pieces and serve immediately.
